turns.question: How many euros more did a social lead cost us than a search lead in September 2026?
turns.answer: In September 2026 (1-30 Sep), cost per lead was 52.50 EUR for social and 42.07 EUR for search (total ad spend over total leads, per channel), so a social lead cost more than a search lead; the semantic layer has no metric for the gap itself, so I give the two figures rather than calculate it myself. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
